data_provenance: SYNTHETIC measurements: combined-light magnitudes are generated from this file's own literature Teff/R/logg via PySeshat's own synthetic_binary_magnitudes(), plus Gaussian noise at an ASSUMED 0.03 mag representative precision -- a forward-model self-consistency check, not a comparison to independently-observed sky photometry (alpha Cen A/B are individually resolved in reality, so real combined-light photometry isn't the natural observable for this pair -- see scripts/build_joint_benchmarks.py module docstring). [M/H]=0.0 (ckp00) is used as the nearest available grid point to the literature's slightly metal-rich estimate, not itself a literature value.
